dialogue.conversations.gulp.hard/1: I remember. I thought I wasn't getting out of there, %1$s. I'm still a little shaken.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.hard/2: You scared me half to death in there. Please don't ever do that again.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.hard/3: Don't remind me. I could feel the walls closing in. I'm just glad I'm out.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.soft/1: Oh, that! It was warm and... honestly kind of cozy. Just ask first next time, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.soft/2: I remember. It felt safe in there, strangely. I trust you, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.soft/3: Funny thing to bring up, but I didn't hate it. Just don't make a habit of it.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.witness/1: I saw what happened to that poor villager. I won't forget it, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.witness/2: Everyone in the village still talks about it. It was horrible.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.witness/3: I remember. I still can't look at you quite the same way.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.saw/1: I saw you carrying someone around. It looked... odd.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.saw/2: I remember seeing you gulp someone down. I hope they were okay.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.none/1: Remember what? I don't know what you're talking about.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.none/2: Stomach? I think you've got the wrong villager, %1$s.
dialogue.conversations.gulp.none/3: Um... no? Is this some kind of joke?
dialogue.gulp.talk/1: Oh? Alright, what's on your mind?
dialogue.gulp.talk/2: Hm, the tummy topic again? Go on.
dialogue.gulp.talk/3: Sure, ask away. I'm all ears.
dialogue.gulp.talk.go_feelings: How do you feel about it all?
dialogue.gulp.talk.memories/1: Ah, the old stories. What do you want to talk about?
dialogue.gulp.talk.memories/2: Memories, huh? Alright, what do you want to know?
dialogue.gulp.talk.memories/3: Sure. I remember more than you'd think.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.hard/1: I remember. I really thought I wasn't getting out of there, %1$s. I'm still a little shaken.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.hard/2: You scared me half to death in there. Please don't ever do that again.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.hard/3: Don't remind me. I could feel the walls closing in. I'm just glad I'm out.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.invm/1: Remember? %1$s, I've lost count of my rides. I practically have a reserved seat!
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.invm/2: Oh, I remember all of them. You carry me so often, I'm basically a regular passenger.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.invm/3: Of course I remember! At this point it's our little tradition, isn't it?
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.inv/1: Oh, that was fun, %1$s! I asked for it, and you took good care of me.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.inv/2: I remember. It was my idea, and I'd happily do it again.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.inv/3: Yes! Cozy, safe, and I trusted you the whole way. Ask me again sometime.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.many/1: We've done that a few times now, haven't we? I'm starting to get used to it.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.many/2: I remember. It's turning into a habit, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.many/3: Yes, quite a few times. I'm beginning to know every corner in there.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.soft/1: Oh, that! It was warm and... honestly kind of cozy. Just ask first next time, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.soft/2: I remember. It felt safe in there, strangely. I trust you, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.soft/3: Funny thing to bring up, but I didn't hate it. Just don't make a habit of it.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.wd/1: I remember what happened to that poor villager. I won't forget it, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.wd/2: Everyone in the village still talks about it. It was horrible.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.wd/3: I remember. I still can't look at you quite the same way.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.ws/1: I saw you carrying someone around. It looked... odd.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.ws/2: I remember seeing you gulp someone down. I hope they were okay.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.none/1: Remember what? I don't know what you're talking about.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.none/2: Stomach? I think you've got the wrong villager, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.ride.none/3: Um... no? Is this some kind of joke?
dialogue.gulp.talk.memories.first: What was the first time like?
dialogue.gulp.say.first.hard/1: Terrifying, honestly. Everything went dark and tight, and I couldn't tell if you'd let me out.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.hard/2: I thought that was the end of me. My heart was pounding the whole time.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.hard/3: I don't want to relive it. It was the scariest moment of my life.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.inv/1: Exciting! I'd been wondering for ages what it would be like, and you were so careful.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.inv/2: I was nervous right up until you gulped me, then it was just warm and quiet.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.inv/3: A bit strange at first, but I felt safe because I'd asked for it.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.soft/1: Strange! A bit squishy, a bit warm, and I couldn't stop giggling.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.soft/2: I wasn't sure what to expect. It was dark, and I could hear everything rumbling.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.soft/3: I was nervous at first, but you kept things gentle. I remember that.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.none/1: The first time for what? Nothing like that has happened to me.
dialogue.gulp.say.first.none/2: I don't know what you mean, %1$s. Was I supposed to have a first time?
dialogue.gulp.say.first.none/3: First time? You'll have to explain that one.
dialogue.gulp.say.longest.long/1: Oh, that long ride! I think I dozed off in there at one point.
dialogue.gulp.say.longest.long/2: A whole minute or more, wasn't it? I lost track of time.
dialogue.gulp.say.longest.long/3: That was the longest ride yet. Honestly? I didn't mind.
dialogue.gulp.say.longest.none/1: Long ride? We've never stayed in there for very long.
dialogue.gulp.say.longest.none/2: I don't remember anything like that.
dialogue.gulp.say.longest.none/3: Not that I recall. Why, how long were you planning?
dialogue.gulp.talk.memories.regular: Do I carry you too much?
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.lots/1: Too much? %1$s, you've carried me more times than I can count. But I'm not complaining.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.lots/2: You're basically a taxi at this point. A very squishy taxi.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.lots/3: If you carry me any more, the other villagers will start charging fares.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.many/1: A fair bit, yes. But I'd tell you if it bothered me.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.many/2: Hm, a few times. It's not too much, I promise.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.many/3: Just enough that I'm comfortable with it.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.any/1: Only a time or two. No complaints from me.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.any/2: Not at all. I'd say we're just getting started.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.any/3: You haven't overdone it, %1$s. Don't worry.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.none/1: Carry me? You haven't carried me at all, %1$s!
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.none/2: I don't think you've carried me even once.
dialogue.gulp.say.regular.none/3: Too much? We haven't done it yet!
dialogue.gulp.talk.memories.saw: Did you see me swallow anyone?
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.wd/1: I saw it, %1$s. I'll never forget what happened to that poor villager.
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.wd/2: Yes. I saw you do it. Please don't make me talk about it.
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.wd/3: I saw. I still can't get it out of my head.
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.ws/1: I saw you gulp someone down. They seemed okay, but it was a strange sight.
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.ws/2: Yes, I saw. I hope whoever it was is alright.
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.ws/3: I did. It looked... uncomfortable, honestly.
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.none/1: No? I haven't seen you swallow anyone, %1$s. Why, who was it?
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.none/2: I don't think so. What are you talking about?
dialogue.gulp.say.saw.none/3: Not that I remember. Should I have?
dialogue.gulp.talk.memories.forgive: Are you still mad at me?
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.low/1: Yes. I haven't forgotten, and I'm not sure I can.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.low/2: Mad? Terrified is closer. Give me time.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.low/3: Please leave me alone for a while.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.high/1: I was, but I know you didn't mean it. We're okay.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.high/2: You've earned my trust back, %1$s. I'm not mad anymore.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.high/3: It still stings a bit, but I forgive you.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.mid/1: A little. Give me some time and be kind to me, and we'll be fine.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.mid/3: Hm. Ask me again after you've been nice to me for a while.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.none/1: Mad? Why would I be mad at you?
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.none/2: Mad about what? I don't know what you mean.
dialogue.gulp.say.forgive.none/3: I'm not mad at you, %1$s. Should I be?
dialogue.gulp.talk.feelings/1: Feelings, huh? Alright, ask me anything.
dialogue.gulp.talk.feelings/2: Oh, you want to know how I feel? Okay.
dialogue.gulp.talk.feelings/3: Sure. I'll be honest with you.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.hardtimid/1: Yes. A little. Okay, a lot. Please be gentle.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.hardtimid/2: I jump every time you walk up behind me. Is that a yes?
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.hardtimid/3: After what happened? Yes. I'm trying not to be.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.hard/1: A bit, yes. After what happened, I'm careful around you.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.hard/2: I'm working on not being. It takes time.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.hard/3: Less than before. But I haven't forgotten.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.wd/1: I've seen what you can do, so... yes, a little.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.wd/2: Some of me is. Some of me wants to believe you're kind.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.wd/3: After what I saw? A bit, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.tough/1: Scared of you? Ha! You'd have to try harder than that.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.tough/2: Please. I'm not scared of anything.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.tough/3: I'd like to see you try... in a fun way.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.cheer/1: Scared? No way! You're too much fun to be scary.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.cheer/2: Oh, you're not scary at all, %1$s! Silly question.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.timidlow/1: Honestly? Everyone makes me nervous. But you're not the worst.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.timidlow/2: A little. It's not you, it's just me. I'm jumpy.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.timidlow/3: I'm scared of most things. You're getting less scary, though.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.high/1: Never. I know you'd take care of me.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.high/2: Scared of you? Not even a little, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.high/3: No. You're one of the safest people I know.
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.none/1: Scared? Not really. Should I be?
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.none/2: Not at all. Why do you ask?
dialogue.gulp.say.scared.none/3: I don't think so, %1$s. Why, what are you planning?
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.hard/1: I'm trying to. After what happened, it isn't easy.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.hard/2: A little. It's hard to trust someone who swallowed you for real.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.hard/3: I want to. Give me time, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.invhigh/1: With my life, %1$s. I even asked you to carry me, didn't I?
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.invhigh/2: Completely. You've proven it every time.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.invhigh/3: More than almost anyone. You've never let me down.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.high/1: Completely. You've never given me a reason not to.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.high/2: Yes. You're one of the people I trust most.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.high/3: Of course, %1$s. Why would you even ask?
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.low/2: I barely know you. Ask me again when we've talked more.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.low/3: Trust is earned. Keep being kind and we'll get there.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.none/1: I think so. You seem like you mean well.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.none/2: Mostly. We're still getting to know each other.
dialogue.gulp.say.trust.none/3: I trust you a little. That's a good start, isn't it?
dialogue.gulp.say.again.hard/2: Once was enough. More than enough.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.hard/3: Not a chance. Ask me something else.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.invm/1: Again? Any time! You know where to find me.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.invm/2: Yes, yes, yes! Just say when, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.invm/3: I'm practically waiting for the invitation.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.inv/1: Yes, if it's like last time. Gentle, and I get to say when.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.inv/2: I think I would. It was kind of fun.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.inv/3: Maybe next time I'll ask you first!
dialogue.gulp.say.again.soft/1: Maybe. If you ask nicely, and promise to let me out when I want.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.soft/2: Hm. I'd have to think about it, but I'm not saying no.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.none/1: Again? We haven't done it once.
dialogue.gulp.say.again.none/3: Again? I don't know what you mean.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.hard/1: Warm? It was stuffy and tight. Not exactly relaxing.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.hard/2: Too warm, too tight, and I couldn't breathe easy.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.hard/3: It was suffocating. I'd rather not talk about it.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.inv/1: Toasty! Better than a campfire, and I didn't even have to roast anything.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.inv/2: Warm and snug, like a big soft blanket.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.inv/3: Cozy! I could have fallen asleep in there.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.soft/1: Surprisingly, yes. Warm and snug, like a big blanket.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.soft/2: It was nice and warm. I won't pretend I hated it.
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.none/1: Warm? What are you talking about?
dialogue.gulp.say.warm.none/2: I haven't been in there, so I couldn't tell you.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.hard/1: All I could hear was my own heart, and it was louder than yours.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.hard/2: I couldn't hear anything over my own panic.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.hard/3: Not really. I was a bit busy being terrified.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.inv/1: Thump, thump, thump. Very steady, very calming.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.inv/2: Yes! It was like a slow, soothing drum.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.inv/3: I could hear it the whole time. It helped me relax.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.soft/1: Yes. It was steady and calm. Kind of soothing, actually.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.soft/2: I could hear it faintly. Thump, thump, thump.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.none/1: Your heartbeat? I'd have to get a lot closer for that.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.none/2: I haven't been close enough to hear it.
dialogue.gulp.say.heartbeat.none/3: No? Should I have been listening for it?
dialogue.gulp.say.today.overjoyed/2: I'm so happy I could burst! Thanks for asking!
dialogue.gulp.say.today.happy/1: Pretty good, thanks! It's a nice day.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.fine/1: Fine, thanks. Just getting on with the day.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.fine/2: I'm alright. Nothing to complain about.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.passive/1: Oh. Okay, I guess. Nothing special.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.passive/2: Meh. I'm just kind of here.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.unhappy/1: Not great, honestly. It's been a rough day.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.unhappy/2: A bit down. Maybe a chat will help.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.sad/1: Sad, to be honest. Thanks for asking, though.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.sad/2: I've been better. It's a gloomy day for me.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.depressed/1: Awful. I don't really want to talk right now.
dialogue.gulp.say.today.depressed/2: Everything feels heavy today. Please be kind.
dialogue.gulp.talk.play/2: Games? Yes, please! What are we doing?
dialogue.gulp.talk.play/3: Finally, someone fun to talk to. Go on!
dialogue.gulp.say.guess.r2: A sword? Please say it's not a sword.
dialogue.gulp.say.guess.r3: A whole roast chicken! I can smell it from here.
dialogue.gulp.say.guess.r4: Nothing at all. I can hear the echo from here.
dialogue.gulp.say.guess.r5: Is it... a loaf of bread?
dialogue.gulp.say.guess.r6: Cobblestone? Why does it sound like cobblestone?
dialogue.gulp.say.guess.r7: A cake! Tell me it's cake.
dialogue.gulp.say.guess.r8: Is it a very small villager? I knew it!
dialogue.gulp.say.guess.r10: A lost sock. I've lost a few of those myself.
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r1: What do you call a stomach that tells jokes? A real gut-buster.
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r2: I told my stomach a secret. Now the whole village knows. It can't keep anything down.
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r3: Why did the sword feel nervous? It heard about the hazard rules.
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r4: What's a stomach's favourite music? Heavy gut-ar.
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r5: Why don't stomachs play hide and seek? It's all gut feelings, no one can hide.
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r6: What did the carrot say to the stomach? Nothing. It was too busy being eaten.
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r7: Why was the potato so calm in your stomach? It had a good skin-care routine.
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r8: How do villagers greet your stomach? 'Hungry? Hmm! Hmm!'
dialogue.gulp.say.joke.r9: What's a stomach's favourite exercise? Digest-ing weights.
dialogue.gulp.talk.play.fortune: Read my fortune from my tummy rumbles
dialogue.gulp.say.fortune.r1: I see... a big meal in your future.
dialogue.gulp.say.fortune.r3: A villager will ask for a ride soon. Say yes, kindly.
dialogue.gulp.say.fortune.r4: Your rumbles say: go find a pie.
dialogue.gulp.say.fortune.r5: Great things come to those who chew.
dialogue.gulp.say.fortune.r6: A long ride awaits you. Pack snacks.
dialogue.gulp.say.fortune.r7: The stars say your stomach is growing. Level up, %1$s!
dialogue.gulp.say.dare.r1: A dare? Alright... *spins in a circle three times* There! Your turn.
dialogue.gulp.say.dare.r2: I dare YOU to share your cake with me.
dialogue.gulp.say.dare.r3: Ha! I dare you to go a whole day without swallowing anything.
dialogue.gulp.say.dare.r4: Okay: I dare YOU to tell the iron golem a joke.
dialogue.gulp.say.dare.r5: Fine. *does a little dance* Happy now?
dialogue.gulp.say.dare.r6: I dare you to say please next time you ask.
dialogue.gulp.say.dare.r7: Dare accepted! *flexes dramatically* I'm very strong.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.cheer/1: Aww, stop it, you're making me blush! You're pretty great yourself, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.cheer/2: Oh, that's so sweet! You just made my whole day.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.cheer/3: Ha! Keep that up and I'll follow you everywhere!
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.tough/1: Ha. Flattery will get you... fairly far, actually.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.tough/3: Not bad, %1$s. Not bad at all.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.timid/1: Oh! Um, thank you. That's really kind of you to say.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.timid/2: N-no one's ever said that to me. Thank you.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.timid/3: That... actually means a lot. Thank you, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.calm/1: That's nice of you. I'll remember it.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.calm/2: Oh, thanks. That brightened my day a little.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.none/1: Thank you. That's a nice thing to say.
dialogue.gulp.say.compliment.none/3: Thanks! You're not so bad yourself.
dialogue.gulp.say.hide.r1: Okay! I'll count to ten... one... two... oh wait, you're right there.
dialogue.gulp.say.hide.r2: Hide and seek? I'm terrible at hiding, but let's go!
dialogue.gulp.say.hide.r3: Ready or not... oh no, you're a better hider than me.
dialogue.gulp.say.hide.r4: Hmm, if you hide in your own stomach, that's cheating.
dialogue.gulp.say.hide.r5: Deal! But no hiding inside anything bigger than a barrel.
dialogue.gulp.talk.gossip/1: You know how the village talks. What do you want to hear?
dialogue.gulp.talk.gossip/2: Gossip? Oh, I know a thing or two. Ask away.
dialogue.gulp.talk.gossip/3: Ears open, voice down. What do you want to know?
dialogue.gulp.talk.gossip.rumor: What do people say about me?
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.wd/1: Honestly? They say you're someone to watch out for. What happened scared people.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.wd/2: People whisper about you, %1$s. Not all of it is kind.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.wd/3: Some villagers cross the street when they see you now.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.lots/1: They call you the village's legendary stomach-keeper.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.lots/2: Stories about you travel faster than the wind, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.lots/3: Half the village wants a ride. The other half pretends they don't.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.ws/1: They say you carry people around in your stomach. Folks find it odd... and a little exciting.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.ws/2: Some say it's strange. Others say it's brave.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.ws/3: The gossip is mixed, %1$s. People can't decide how they feel.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.none/1: Nothing much, yet. Give them time, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.none/2: Not a word. You're a mystery around here.
dialogue.gulp.say.rumor.none/3: I haven't heard anything, but I'll let you know.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.lots/1: Famous? You're a legend, %1$s! Even the travelling merchants know your name.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.lots/2: Everybody's heard of you. It's almost annoying.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.lots/3: If they made statues of people, you'd have three by now.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.many/1: People know who you are, yes. Mostly good things.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.many/2: Getting there! A few more rides and you'll be a celebrity.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.ws/1: A little. Some villagers have noticed you.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.ws/2: They know your face, at least.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.ws/3: You're a bit of a talking point lately.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.none/1: Not yet, but you've got potential.
dialogue.gulp.say.famous.none/2: Famous? I couldn't pick you out of a crowd, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.talk.gossip.fear: Are the villagers afraid of me?
dialogue.gulp.say.fear.wd/1: Some are. They saw what happened, and they won't forget it.
dialogue.gulp.say.fear.wd/2: A few, yes. They keep their distance now.
dialogue.gulp.say.fear.high/1: Not me, and not the ones who know you well.
dialogue.gulp.say.fear.high/2: The ones who know you aren't. The others are still deciding.
dialogue.gulp.say.fear.high/3: You've got friends here, %1$s. Remember that.
dialogue.gulp.say.fear.none/1: Afraid? I don't think so. Curious, mostly.
dialogue.gulp.say.advice.r1: Always ask before you swallow someone. It's just polite.
dialogue.gulp.say.advice.r2: Soft mode is gentle. Hard mode is only for people who've truly agreed to it.
dialogue.gulp.say.advice.r3: If someone wants out, let them out. No arguments.
dialogue.gulp.say.advice.r4: Don't swallow anything sharp. Trust me, it never ends well.
dialogue.gulp.say.advice.r5: Chat with your passengers! They get bored in there.
dialogue.gulp.say.advice.r6: Remember: trust is built one gentle ride at a time.
dialogue.gulp.say.advice.r7: Keep your snacks organised. I hear the stomach gets messy.
dialogue.gulp.say.advice.r8: Drink some water. Stomachs need hydration too, I hear.
dialogue.gulp.say.news.r1: A chicken laid three eggs in one day. The baker is suspicious.
dialogue.gulp.say.news.r2: Someone saw a cow near the well. Nobody knows how it got there.
dialogue.gulp.say.news.r3: The blacksmith dropped his hammer into a bucket. He says he's cursed.
dialogue.gulp.say.news.r4: A cat followed the librarian for three days.
dialogue.gulp.say.news.r5: The farmers say the carrots are growing sideways this year.
dialogue.gulp.say.news.r6: I heard a rumour about treasure under the old oak. Probably nothing.
dialogue.gulp.say.news.r7: There was a strange noise last night. It was just the golem sneezing.
dialogue.gulp.talk.ask/1: Sure, go ahead. What's your question?
dialogue.gulp.talk.ask/2: A question? Alright, I'll do my best.
dialogue.gulp.talk.ask.howto: How do I carry someone safely?
dialogue.gulp.say.howto.r1: Ask first. Being polite goes a long way, even with villagers.
dialogue.gulp.say.howto.r2: Keep it soft if you want folks to trust you. Soft mode never hurts anyone.
dialogue.gulp.say.howto.r3: Let people out whenever they ask. That's the golden rule.
dialogue.gulp.say.howto.r4: Check your stomach capacity. Big passengers need a big stomach.
dialogue.gulp.say.howto.r5: Let go of anyone who struggles. It's the kind thing to do.
dialogue.gulp.say.howto.r6: A good host chats with their guests. Don't just stay silent!
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.invhigh/1: You know I'd love to, %1$s. If I feel the urge, I'll ask you myself.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.invhigh/2: Always! Stay close, and I'll let you know when I'm ready.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.invhigh/3: Don't tempt me. I might just ask you first!
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.high/1: Hm... you've got my trust. Stay close, and I might ask you myself sometime.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.high/2: Maybe. I like you enough, %1$s. Stay nearby.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.high/3: I'll think about it. Keep being kind to me.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.mid/1: Maybe someday. Let's get to know each other a bit better first.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.mid/2: Not yet, but I'm not saying never.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.mid/3: Ask me again when we're better friends.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.none/1: A ride in your stomach? We barely know each other! No.
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.none/2: Absolutely not. I just met you!
dialogue.gulp.say.offer.none/3: No, thanks. I don't know you well enough.
dialogue.gulp.talk.ask.safe: Do you feel safe around me?
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.hard/1: Safe? After what happened... I'm trying to.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.hard/2: Not as safe as before. But I'm working on it.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.hard/3: I want to. Give me time, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.inv/1: Completely safe. You always make sure I'm alright.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.inv/2: Yes! You've never given me a reason not to.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.high/1: Yes. You're one of the people I trust most.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.high/3: I do. You've been good to me.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.low/1: I don't know you well enough to say.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.low/3: Ask me again once we're friends.
dialogue.gulp.say.safe.none/1: I think so. You seem decent.
dialogue.gulp.talk.ask.promise: I promise I'll never hurt you.
dialogue.gulp.say.promise.hard/1: That's a big promise, %1$s. After last time, I'll believe it when I see it.
dialogue.gulp.say.promise.hard/3: I want to believe you. I really do.
dialogue.gulp.say.promise.low/1: Promises are easy to make. Show me.
dialogue.gulp.say.promise.low/2: We barely know each other. Prove it.
dialogue.gulp.say.promise.none/2: That means a lot to me.
dialogue.gulp.say.promise.none/3: I'll hold you to that, you know.
dialogue.gulp.say.sorry.high/1: ...I forgive you. Just never do it again.
dialogue.gulp.say.sorry.high/2: Thank you for saying it, %1$s. I forgive you.
dialogue.gulp.say.sorry.high/3: It was scary, but I know you're sorry. We're okay.
dialogue.gulp.say.sorry.hard/1: Sorry doesn't undo it. But... thank you for saying it.
dialogue.gulp.say.sorry.hard/2: It means something that you apologise. I'm still hurting, though.
dialogue.gulp.say.sorry.hard/3: I appreciate it, %1$s. Give me time.
dialogue.gulp.say.sorry.none/1: Sorry for what? You haven't done anything to me.
dialogue.gulp.say.sorry.none/2: Sorry? I don't know what you mean.
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.inv/1: Of course, %1$s. I asked for it, and you proved I was right to.
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.inv/2: Always. You take such good care of me.
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.inv/3: Thank you for being so careful. That's why I trust you.
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.high/3: Of course. That's what friends do.
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.soft/1: It was an adventure. Thanks for being gentle.
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.soft/2: I'm glad it went well. Thank you, %1$s.
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.soft/3: You were kind about it. That's all I wanted.
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.none/1: Trusting you with what? Sure, I suppose?
dialogue.gulp.say.thanks.none/2: Thanks? I... you're welcome, I guess.
